```{r}

data_raw <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/berkasku/SEMESTER 5/ANMUL/data set uts anmul.csv",
  sep = ";",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("DIMENSI DATA AWAL\n")
print(dim(data_raw))

cat("\nNAMA VARIABEL\n")
print(names(data_raw))

cat("\nSTRUKTUR DATA\n")
str(data_raw)

cat("\nLIMA BARIS PERTAMA\n")
print(head(data_raw))

cat("\nJUMLAH MISSING VALUE PER VARIABEL\n")
print(colSums(is.na(data_raw)))

cat("\nJUMLAH BARIS DUPLIKAT PADA DATA AWAL\n")
print(sum(duplicated(data_raw)))


# ============================================================
# CLEANING DAN PREPROCESSING
# ============================================================

variabel_pilih <- c(
  "G3", "studytime", "failures",
  "absences", "Medu", "Fedu"
)

# Memastikan semua variabel yang dibutuhkan tersedia
if (!all(variabel_pilih %in% names(data_raw))) {
  stop("Ada variabel yang tidak ditemukan. Periksa nama kolom data.")
}

data_pilih <- data_raw[, variabel_pilih, drop = FALSE]

# Konversi ke numerik
data_pilih[] <- lapply(data_pilih, function(x) {
  as.numeric(as.character(x))
})

# Hitung data yang hilang setelah konversi
cat("\nMISSING VALUE PADA VARIABEL PENELITIAN\n")
print(colSums(is.na(data_pilih)))

# Hapus baris dengan missing value
data_bersih <- data_pilih[complete.cases(data_pilih), ]

# Memeriksa rentang nilai yang valid
baris_valid <- with(
  data_bersih,
  G3 >= 0 & G3 <= 20 &
    studytime %in% 1:4 &
    failures >= 0 & failures <= 4 &
    absences >= 0 &
    Medu %in% 0:4 &
    Fedu %in% 0:4
)

data_bersih <- data_bersih[baris_valid, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(data_bersih) < 10) {
  stop("Data valid terlalu sedikit. Periksa format dan isi CSV.")
}

cat("\nJUMLAH BARIS DATA AWAL:", nrow(data_raw), "\n")
cat("JUMLAH BARIS DATA BERSIH:", nrow(data_bersih), "\n")
cat("JUMLAH BARIS YANG TIDAK DIGUNAKAN:",
    nrow(data_raw) - nrow(data_bersih), "\n")

cat("\nDUPLIKASI PADA VARIABEL TERPILIH:",
    sum(duplicated(data_bersih)), "\n")

print(summary(data_bersih))

write.csv(
  data_bersih,
  "output/student_por_bersih.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS (EDA)
# ============================================================

statistik_deskriptif <- data.frame(
  Variabel = names(data_bersih),
  Jumlah = sapply(data_bersih, length),
  Mean = sapply(data_bersih, mean),
  Median = sapply(data_bersih, median),
  Standar_Deviasi = sapply(data_bersih, sd),
  Minimum = sapply(data_bersih, min),
  Maksimum = sapply(data_bersih, max)
)

cat("\nSTATISTIK DESKRIPTIF\n")
print(statistik_deskriptif, row.names = FALSE)

# Histogram nilai akhir
hist(
  data_bersih$G3,
  main = "Distribusi Nilai Akhir Bahasa Portugis",
  xlab = "Nilai Akhir (G3)",
  ylab = "Frekuensi",
  col = "#F4B6C2",
  border = "white",
  breaks = seq(-0.5, 20.5, by = 1)
)

# Boxplot nilai akhir
boxplot(
  data_bersih$G3,
  main = "Sebaran Nilai Akhir Siswa",
  ylab = "Nilai Akhir (G3)",
  col = "#C9B6E4",
  border = "#8E78B7"
)

# Nilai akhir berdasarkan waktu belajar
boxplot(
  G3 ~ factor(studytime),
  data = data_bersih,
  main = "Nilai Akhir Berdasarkan Waktu Belajar",
  xlab = "Waktu Belajar per Minggu",
  ylab = "Nilai Akhir (G3)",
  names = c("<2 jam", "2-5 jam", "5-10 jam", ">10 jam"),
  col = c("#F4B6C2", "#F8D7A3", "#B9DCC4", "#B8D4F0")
)

# Nilai akhir berdasarkan jumlah kegagalan kelas sebelumnya
boxplot(
  G3 ~ factor(failures),
  data = data_bersih,
  main = "Nilai Akhir Berdasarkan Kegagalan Kelas",
  xlab = "Jumlah Kegagalan Sebelumnya",
  ylab = "Nilai Akhir (G3)",
  col = "#D6C6F0"
)

# Ketidakhadiran dan nilai akhir
plot(
  data_bersih$absences,
  data_bersih$G3,
  main = "Ketidakhadiran dan Nilai Akhir",
  xlab = "Jumlah Ketidakhadiran",
  ylab = "Nilai Akhir (G3)",
  pch = 19,
  col = "#91B8E8"
)

# Matriks korelasi untuk eksplorasi awal
cat("\nMATRIKS KORELASI\n")
print(round(cor(data_bersih), 3))

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# REGRESI LINEAR BERGANDA (MODEL AWAL)
# ============================================================

model_mlr <- lm(
  G3 ~ studytime + failures + absences + Medu + Fedu,
  data = data_bersih
)

cat("\nRINGKASAN MODEL MLR AWAL\n")
print(summary(model_mlr))

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SELEKSI VARIABEL DENGAN AIC
# ============================================================

model_aic <- step(
  model_mlr,
  direction = "both",
  trace = 0
)

cat("\nMODEL TERPILIH BERDASARKAN AIC\n")
print(formula(model_aic))

cat("\nRINGKASAN MODEL AIC\n")
print(summary(model_aic))

cat("\nPERBANDINGAN AIC MODEL\n")
print(AIC(model_mlr, model_aic))

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# UJI ASUMSI MODEL TERPILIH
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) {
}

if (!requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)) {
}

if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) {
}

# Normalitas residual

cat("\nUJI NORMALITAS RESIDUAL\n")
if (length(residuals(model_aic)) <= 5000) {
  print(shapiro.test(residuals(model_aic)))
} else {
  cat("Jumlah residual melebihi batas Shapiro-Wilk.\n")
}

# Multikolinearitas
cat("\nUJI MULTIKOLINEARITAS (VIF)\n")
print(car::vif(model_aic))

# Heteroskedastisitas
cat("\nUJI BREUSCH-PAGAN\n")
print(lmtest::bptest(model_aic))

```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# ROBUST STANDARD ERRORS
# ============================================================

cat("\nKOEFISIEN DENGAN ROBUST STANDARD ERRORS HC3\n")
hasil_robust <- lmtest::coeftest(
  model_aic,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model_aic, type = "HC3")
)
print(hasil_robust)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# GRAFIK DIAGNOSTIK MODEL TERPILIH
# ============================================================

par(
  mfrow = c(2, 2),
  bg = "white",
  mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1)
)

plot(model_aic, which = 1, col = "#E78FB3", pch = 19)
plot(model_aic, which = 2, col = "#91B8E8", pch = 19)
plot(model_aic, which = 3, col = "#A8CFA8", pch = 19)
plot(model_aic, which = 5, col = "#C3A6E8", pch = 19)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

```{r}


# STATISTIK DESKRIPTIF SELURUH VARIABEL PENELITIAN

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

statistik_deskriptif <- data_bersih %>%
  select(G3, studytime, failures, absences, Medu, Fedu) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      list(
        N = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
        Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Minimum = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Maksimum = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Variabel", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(N|Mean|Median|SD|Minimum|Maksimum)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Mean, Median, SD), ~round(., 2))
  )

knitr::kable(
  statistik_deskriptif,
  caption = "Statistik Deskriptif Seluruh Variabel Penelitian",
  align = "c"
)


```
